blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–The Philippine women’s football team was relegated to a presumptive quarterfinal matchup with defending champion Japan after being handed a 5-1 loss by China in its final Group G match in the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games. Hopes of getting at least a draw diminished when the Filipinas found no answer for the talismanic Yanwen Wang, who came away with a hat trick, including the two goals that put China ahead in the first half.
